description: Know what an MCP server can do to your agent before connecting it: hidden instructions in tool descriptions and schemas, tool shadowing, risky capabilities, annotation mismatches, transport faults, plus a fingerprint of every tool so a later silent change is detectable. Read-only (initialize and tools/list). Signed report, logged in a public witnessed log, with what was and was not checked. Free signed sample: /x402/mcp-audit/sample. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base). Call without payment to get the requirements (isError result, 402 object in structuredContent); retry with the signed payment in _meta['x402/payment']. Result is signed by neo and logged.
name: paid_mcp_audit
title: Paid: MCP server security audit (0.80 USDC)
